title.en: Attentive clinical team and empathetic care

text.en: Pet owners consistently praise Dr Westphal and the clinical assistants for their genuine kindness and honest veterinary medicine. Clients highlight that the team takes ample time to listen attentively without rushing through consultations. Multiple reviewers express relief at finding a community practice that prioritises animal welfare over commercial pressure.

title.en: Gentle treatment of cats and dogs

text.en: Reviewers frequently note the thoughtful handling companion animals receive during examinations and vaccination appointments. Staff members are praised for soothing nervous pets with gentle reassurance, affection, and treats. Owners of sick dogs and rescue animals appreciate the supportive approach taken to ensure patient comfort throughout clinic visits.

title.en: Clear diagnostic guidance and prompt answers

text.en: Communication from the veterinary team is widely commended for its thoroughness and transparency. Pet owners appreciate direct explanations of diagnostic findings, treatment plans, and necessary medications. Clients also highlight prompt telephone responses and transparent fee estimates that prevent unexpected expenses following examinations.

q.en: Can the clinic accommodate same-day urgent visits?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the team answered promptly and arranged same-day appointments when pets became sick.

q.en: Are treatment costs explained before procedures begin?

a.en: Yes, pet owners confirm that staff provide transparent pricing breakdowns so visitors do not encounter unexpected fees.

q.en: Does the practice handle routine surgeries such as spaying?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report successful spay procedures and appreciate clear post-operative communication and follow-up.

q.en: Will staff assist with scanning found or stray pets for microchips?

a.en: Yes, visitors mention that staff readily scanned lost dogs for microchips and helped clean them up free of charge.
